notes.title: UNDERSEA 8 Major Updates
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[h3]Game Graphics[/h3]
Volumetric fog has been applied to the levels.
It appears in graphics quality 'High' or higher.

[h3]Added settings options[/h3]
Added options for gamma, motion blur, and water ripples to the settings.
If you feel motion sickness during the game, adjust or turn off these options.

[h3]Improved presentation[/h3]
Some anomalies have been reworked to enhance the presentation.

[h3]Lowered difficulty of the last level of normal mode[/h3]
Two checkpoints have been added to the last level of normal mode.
Now, you can die without worry!

[h3]Reworked Ending B[/h3]
Ending B has been reworked to enhance the presentation.
Also, after completing the ending, players can clearly see that they have completed the ending.
A retry function has been added after completing the ending. 
The retry button will restart from the last checkpoint, making it easier to see other endings.

notes.title: Bug fixes and feature additions
notes.content:
[h2]Bug where all anormalies are reported[/h2]
[h3]Bug fix[/h3]
There was a bug where all anormalies were considered to have been found if you quit the game immediately after starting the game for the first time and then restarted the game, so this has been fixed. I'm sorry for the delay in finding the bug.

[h3]Add features to main menu[/h3]
For those who have experienced the above bug, a 'Delete Reports' button has been added to the main menu.
If you press the button, the record of anormalies discovered will be reset.
If you have not encountered the above bug, you can ignore it.



[h2]Balance adjustment[/h2]
[h3]Increased aggression of some anomalies[/h3]
The aggression of Krakens and Skeletons has increased significantly.
Since it no longer crawls leisurely, it has become quite a menacing foe.

[h3]Difficulty of last level of classic mode lowered[/h3]
The difficulty level has been lowered for those who are not familiar with the platform genre.

notes.title: Undersea 8 - Summer Vacation Discount
notes.content:
Because it overlaps with the launch discount, we were unable to participate in the summer season sale, but instead started the discount late.

There is a 40% off sale for two weeks, so why not go on a vacation to the cool sea on a hot summer day?

notes.title: 1.0.6a minor update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the 'What the F...' achievement could not be obtained.

We are truly sorry for the delay in discovering and fixing the bug.

notes.title: Improved convenience
notes.content:
[h1]Improved convenience[/h1]
[h2]Mark safe area[/h2]
At the starting point of each mode, a UI was displayed indicating that there were no anormalies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022176/8bee007fe832dff232b18f3a8ed155baaa9979e8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Added resupply function[/h2]
Oxygen is now resupplied when the depth is reset due to a misjudgment in normal mode.
If the current amount of oxygen is less than the amount received at the start of the mode, it is automatically charged to 18%.
If the amount of oxygen you have is higher than this, it will remain as is.

[h2]Improved camera scanning method [/h2]
We have improved the function so that even if the anormalies deviates from the aiming point to some extent, the anormaly is considered to have been captured.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022176/dfd48494f94f60c9c64051a087e09ed587ed0f14.jpg[/img]

[h2]New ending added[/h2]
[h3]Added new ending ‘Deepest Place’ and related achievements.[/h3]
Based on the judgment that it may be unpleasant to experience failure after a long chase in the last level,
Added a new ending and made it possible to finish the game.

[h2]Level structure modification[/h2]
[h3]Normal mode last level[/h3]
Added new stairs near the entrance.
As a new ending is added, this staircase will take over the role played by the existing ‘last staircase’.

[h3]Classic mode last level[/h3]
We added footrests to some sections to allow for a smoother climb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022176/2badb5ec9163a3fec302e4e21e0b94833693323d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other[/h2]
Fixed a few typos.

notes.title: v 1.0.3 - Be kinder
notes.content:
[h1]Easier[/h1]
[h2]Exit 8 level[/h2]
This level's resolution method was too difficult to recognize, so it was modified.
The location of the trigger that opens the door in 'exit 8' level has been moved to the front of the corner.
Additionally, a sound was added when the trigger was activated so that it could be clearly recognized.
I apologize for any inconvenience caused.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022176/c4bd38097fc046ac5b6fda51a527ad082c48200d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other anomalies[/h2]
Hints were added and reinforced for anomalies that had a low detection probability.

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
[h3]Bug where oxygen does not decrease[/h3]
Fixed a bug where oxygen did not decrease after going up the stairs in exit 8 level.

[h2]Add Achievements[/h2]
[h3]Added 2 secret achievements.[/h3]
I hope it brings comfort to some and laughter to others...

notes.title: v 1.0.2 - Lowered game difficulty, improved gameplay
notes.content:
[h1]Game difficulty lowered[/h1]
First of all... I'm sorry! The difficulty level of the game was too high.
Classic mode was written as an easy difficulty, but the actual difficulty was not easy at all.
This is all my fault for trying to increase a playing time.
Even if I get hit with a hammer, I have nothing to say.

In v 1.0.2, it changes as follows.

[h2]Decreased water depth by mode[/h2]
The default depth for each mode changes.
Classic mode: Changed from 1000m to 800m.
Normal mode: Changed from 1300m to 1200m.

[h2]Change in the appearance method of anormalies[/h2]
In the previous version, anomalies were classified according to the depth of the water, from those that were easy to detect to those that were difficult to detect...
The anomalies that appear in the latter half of the story are so difficult to detect that they keep getting reset.
In the beginning, there were many problems, such as seeing the same anormalies over and over again.
Starting with v 1.0.2, all anormalies will have the same probability to appear regardless of mode and water depth.

[h2]Difficulty of some anormalies lowered[/h2]
Some anomalies were extremely difficult to detect.
We have adjusted the shape, size, and color of these anomalies to make them more noticeable.

[h1]Improved gameplay[/h1]
[h2]Optimization of movement lines[/h2]
Areas where exploration is unnecessary because no abnormalities have occurred have been blocked so that movement is not possible.

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the area where you could get stuck in the stones in the last level of Classic Mode.
[*] Prevented players from being deprived of oxygen by insects while already dead in the final level of normal mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Undersea 8 Launch & 40% Discount
notes.content:
We just released Undersea 8.

To celebrate the launch, we are offering a 40% discount!

notes.title: Release date notice
notes.content:
The release date scheduled for the end of May has been slightly postponed.
There are currently some bugs and some finishing touches left to improve quality.
After fixing this, we will release the game on June 3rd.
